title: Test forms approximate a continuous compactly supported covector field uniformly (mollification)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let h : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) be continuous with compact support. Here Λⁿ(ℝ^P) = Covector (Euclid P) n, the n-covectors with the operator norm. Then there is a sequence (ω_j)_{j∈ℕ} of test forms ω_j ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (elements of TestFormOn univ n, i.e. C^∞ n-forms with compact support) converging to h uniformly on ℝ^P: sup_x ‖ω_j(x) − h(x)‖ → 0 as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∃ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, TendstoUniformly (fun j x => (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) h atTop
